function ib takes nothing returns nothing
local integer GI=GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(kv))
local integer i=GetRandomInt(0,99)
if(i<50)then
call SetUnitAnimation(kv,"spell slam")
call TI(kv,2+zx[GI*6+3]/ 3,2+zx[GI*6+5]/ 2,75.*IMinBJ(1+zx[GI*6+1],4))
else
call SetUnitAnimation(kv,"spell throw")
call JR(kv,5+zx[GI*6+4]*2,75.*IMinBJ(1+zx[GI*6+2],4),IMaxBJ(IMinBJ(zx[GI*6+5]/ 4,3),1))
endif
endfunction

handlers.name: TI
handlers.body:
function TI takes unit u,integer uI,integer UI,real KR returns nothing
local player p=GetOwningPlayer(u)
local real an=GetUnitFacing(u)
local integer i=0
local boolean wI=Xe==0
local real WI=(an+90.)*bj_DEGTORAD
local real yI=-50.*I2R(uI/ 2)+50.*ModuloInteger(uI+1,2)/ 2.
local real x=GetUnitX(u)+30.*CosBJ(an)
local real y=GetUnitY(u)+30.*SinBJ(an)
local real YI=Sin(WI)
set WI=Cos(WI)
loop
set oe[Xe]=CreateUnit(p,'h03H',x+yI*WI,y+yI*YI,an)
set re[Xe]=400.
set ie[Xe]=UI
set ae[Xe]=0
set ne[Xe]=null
set Ve[Xe]=KR
set Ee[Xe]=false
set yI=yI+(50.)
set Xe=Xe+1
set i=i+1
exitwhen i>=uI
endloop
set Ee[Xe-1]=true
if(wI)then
call TimerStart(xe,.03,true,function tI)
endif
endfunction

function SI takes integer KO returns nothing
local real an=GetUnitFacing(oe[KO])
call SetUnitFacing(oe[KO],an-30.)
set ie[KO]=ie[KO]-1
set ae[KO]=1
set re[KO]=50.
set oe[Xe]=CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(oe[KO]),'h03H',GetUnitX(oe[KO]),GetUnitY(oe[KO]),an+30.)
set re[Xe]=50.
set ie[Xe]=ie[KO]
set ae[Xe]=-1
set ne[Xe]=null
set Ve[Xe]=Ve[KO]
set Ee[Xe]=false
set Xe=Xe+1
endfunction

handlers.name: tI
handlers.body:
function tI takes nothing returns nothing
local integer i=0
local real x
local real y
local real an
local unit u
loop
exitwhen i>=Xe
set an=GetUnitFacing(oe[i])*bj_DEGTORAD
set x=GetUnitX(oe[i])+20.*Cos(an)
set y=GetUnitY(oe[i])+20.*Sin(an)
call SetUnitX(oe[i],x)
call SetUnitY(oe[i],y)
set Bv=GetOwningPlayer(oe[i])
set bj_lastLoadedUnit=ne[i]
call GroupEnumUnitsInRange(Nv,x,y,34.,Oe)
set u=FirstOfGroup(Nv)
if(u!=null)then
call UnitDamageTarget(oe[i],u,Ve[i],true,false,ATTACK_TYPE_MAGIC,DAMAGE_TYPE_LIGHTNING,WEAPON_TYPE_WHOKNOWS)
call DestroyEffect(AddSpecialEffect("Abilities\\Weapons\\Bolt\\BoltImpact.mdl",GetUnitX(u),GetUnitY(u)))
set ne[i]=u
endif
set re[i]=re[i]-(20.)
if(re[i]<=.0)then
if(ae[i]==0)then
if(ie[i]>0)then
call SI(i)
else
set Xe=Xe-1
call KillUnit(oe[i])
set oe[i]=oe[Xe]
set re[i]=re[Xe]
set ie[i]=ie[Xe]
set ae[i]=ae[Xe]
set ne[i]=ne[Xe]
set Ve[i]=Ve[Xe]
set Ee[i]=Ee[Xe]
endif
else
if(ae[i]>0 and not Ee[i])then
set Xe=Xe-1
call KillUnit(oe[i])
set oe[i]=oe[Xe]
set re[i]=re[Xe]
set ie[i]=ie[Xe]
set ae[i]=ae[Xe]
set ne[i]=ne[Xe]
set Ve[i]=Ve[Xe]
set Ee[i]=Ee[Xe]
else
set re[i]=400.
call SetUnitFacing(oe[i],an*bj_RADTODEG+ae[i]*30.)
set ae[i]=0
endif
endif
else
set i=i+1
endif
endloop
if(Xe<=0)then
call PauseTimer(xe)
endif
set u=null
endfunction

handlers.name: JR
handlers.body:
function JR takes unit u,integer kR,real KR,integer lR returns nothing
local player p=GetOwningPlayer(u)
local real an=GetUnitFacing(u)-45.
local real LR=an+90.
local real x=GetUnitX(u)
local real y=GetUnitY(u)
local integer i=0
loop
set T[Z]=CreateUnit(p,'h068',x,y,GetRandomReal(an,LR))
set U[Z]=500.
set W[Z]=KR
set Y[Z]=lR
if(Z==0)then
call TimerStart(S,.03,true,function jR)
endif
set Z=Z+1
set i=i+1
call TriggerSleepAction(.04)
exitwhen i>=kR
endloop
endfunction

handlers.name: jR
handlers.body:
function jR takes nothing returns nothing
	local integer i=0
	local real x
	local real y
	local real an
	local unit u
	local unit j
	loop
		exitwhen i>=Z
		set an=GetUnitFacing(T[i])*bj_DEGTORAD
		set x=GetUnitX(T[i])+26.*Cos(an)
		set y=GetUnitY(T[i])+26.*Sin(an)
		call SetUnitX(T[i],x)
		call SetUnitY(T[i],y)
		set Bv=GetOwningPlayer(T[i])
		call GroupEnumUnitsInRange(Nv,x,y,34.,vv)
		set u=FirstOfGroup(Nv)
		if(u!=null)then
			call UnitDamageTarget(T[i],u,W[i],true,false,ATTACK_TYPE_MAGIC,DAMAGE_TYPE_COLD,WEAPON_TYPE_WHOKNOWS)
			set j=CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(T[i]),'e008',x,y,.0)
			call UnitAddAbility(j,'A043')
			call SetUnitAbilityLevel(j,'A043',Y[i])
			call IssueTargetOrderById(j,$D0102,u)
			call UnitApplyTimedLife(j,'BTLF',1.)
			set j=null
		endif
		set U[i]=U[i]-(26.)
		if(U[i]<=.0 or u!=null)then
			set Z=Z-1
			call KillUnit(T[i])
			set T[i]=T[Z]
			set U[i]=U[Z]
			set Y[i]=Y[Z]
			set W[i]=W[Z]
			set u=null
		else
			set i=i+1
		endif
	endloop
	if(Z<=0)then
		call PauseTimer(S)
	endif
	set u=null
endfunction

handlers.name: nh
handlers.body:
function nh takes nothing returns boolean
local unit s=GetEventDamageSource()
local unit u=GetTriggerUnit()
local integer Vh
if(GetUnitAbilityLevel(s,'A03Q')>0)then
if(GetUnitAbilityLevel(s,'A0F1')>0)then
call oh(s,.5*GetEventDamage(),GetUnitX(u),GetUnitY(u),IsUnitType(s,UNIT_TYPE_ATTACKS_GROUND),IsUnitType(s,UNIT_TYPE_ATTACKS_FLYING))
endif
set Vh=GetUnitTypeId(s)
if(Vh=='u00D')then
call PG(s,u)
elseif(Vh=='h05L')then
call qG(s,u)
elseif(Vh=='h061')then
call QG(s,u)
elseif(Vh=='n02A')then
call sG(u)
elseif(Vh=='n02B')then
call UnitRemoveAbility(s,'A0C8')
elseif(Vh=='e006')then
call TG(u)
elseif(Vh=='e009')then
call uG(u)
elseif(Vh=='e00C')then
call wG(s,u)
elseif(GetUnitAbilityLevel(s,'A0DW')>0)then
call DisableTrigger(ln)
call UnitDamageTarget(s,u,50.*GetUnitLevel(s)*GetWidgetLife(s)/ GetUnitState(s,UNIT_STATE_MAX_LIFE),true,false,ATTACK_TYPE_SIEGE,DAMAGE_TYPE_DEMOLITION,WEAPON_TYPE_WHOKNOWS)
call EnableTrigger(ln)
elseif(Vh=='h02Y')then
call YG(s)
endif
endif
if(GetWidgetLife(u)>.405 and GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A0C5')>0)then
set Vh=GetUnitTypeId(u)
if(Vh=='n029')then
call SG(u)
if(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A0C4')>0 and GetWidgetLife(u)<255.)then
call Dg(u)
else
call UnitRemoveAbility(u,'Asla')
call UnitRemoveAbility(u,'A0C6')
endif
elseif(Vh=='n02B')then
call tG(u)
if(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A0C4')>0 and GetWidgetLife(u)<255.)then
call dg(u)
else
call UnitRemoveAbility(u,'Asla')
call UnitRemoveAbility(u,'A0C7')
endif
elseif(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A0DX')>0)then
call WG(s,u)
elseif(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A0EZ')>0)then
call eh(u)
elseif(Vh=='o00E')then
call vh(u,GetEventDamage())
endif
endif
if(Vi)then
call wC(u)
endif
set u=null
set s=null
return false
endfunction

function oh takes unit IO,real rh,real x,real y,boolean ih,boolean ah returns nothing
local player p=GetOwningPlayer(IO)
local unit u=CreateUnit(p,'e008',x,y,.0)
local unit j
set Bv=p
set Ln=ih
set mn=ah
call GroupEnumUnitsInRange(Nv,x,y,250.,Mn)
loop
set j=FirstOfGroup(Nv)
exitwhen j==null
call GroupRemoveUnit(Nv,j)
call UnitDamageTarget(u,j,rh,true,false,ATTACK_TYPE_CHAOS,DAMAGE_TYPE_UNKNOWN,WEAPON_TYPE_WHOKNOWS)
endloop
call UnitApplyTimedLife(u,'BTLF',1.)
set u=null
set j=null
endfunction

function Ab takes nothing returns nothing
local real r
local integer vb
set Bv=GetOwningPlayer(Hv)
set xo=false
call GroupEnumUnitsInRect(Nv,gg_rct_MapArea,eo)
set bj_groupRandomCurrentPick=PN(Nv)
if(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick==null)then
set xo=true
call GroupEnumUnitsInRect(Nv,gg_rct_MapArea,eo)
set bj_groupRandomCurrentPick=PN(Nv)
if(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick==null)then
return
endif
endif
call DestroyEffect(AddSpecialEffectTarget("Abilities\\Spells\\Human\\HolyBolt\\HolyBoltSpecialArt.mdl",bj_groupRandomCurrentPick,"overhead"))

set r=GetWidgetLife(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick)
if(GetUnitState(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick,UNIT_STATE_MAX_LIFE)-r>350.)then
call SetWidgetLife(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick,r+450.)
else
set oo[0]='A0D7'
set oo[1]='A0F3'
set oo[2]='A0F1'
set ro=3
set vb=0
loop
exitwhen vb>=ro
if(GetUnitAbilityLevel(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick,oo[vb])>0)then
set ro=ro-1
set oo[vb]=oo[ro]
else
set vb=vb+1
endif
endloop
if(ro<=0)then
call SetWidgetLife(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick,r+450.)
else
set vb=GetRandomInt(0,ro-1)
call UnitAddAbility(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick,oo[vb])
if(vb==2)then
call UnitAddAbility(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick,'A03Q')
endif
call UnitAddAbility(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick,'A0F4')
endif
endif
endfunction

				elseif(t=='h01U' and GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A08H')<=0 and(not IsUnitType(u,UNIT_TYPE_MECHANICAL))and(not IsUnitType(u,UNIT_TYPE_UNDEAD)))then
					call mG(k,u,'h01V')
					set u=null
				elseif(t=='h05H' and GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A08H')<=0 and(not IsUnitType(u,UNIT_TYPE_MECHANICAL))and(not IsUnitType(u,UNIT_TYPE_UNDEAD)))then
					call mG(k,u,'h01U')
					set u=null
				elseif(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A07M')>=1)then
					call AB(u)
				endif
			endif
			if(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A07G')<=0 and GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A07H')<=0 and not IsUnitType(u,UNIT_TYPE_SUMMONED))then
				set t=ea[GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(u))]

					if(u!=null and GetWidgetLife(u)<.405 and GetRandomInt(0,99)<IMinBJ(hi[t],40))then

						if(GetUnitAbilityLevel(k,'A07M')>=1)then
							call NB(k)
							call GroupAddUnit(er,k)
						endif
					endif
				endif
			endif
		endif
	elseif(IsUnitType(u,UNIT_TYPE_STRUCTURE))then
		call ZR(u)
		call eF(GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(u)),u)
		if(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A0EL')>0)then
			call Eb(u)
		endif
		set t=GetUnitTypeId(u)
		if(t=='h05G')then
			call wf(u)
		elseif(t=='h059')then
			call Jf(u)
		elseif(t=='h063')then
			call Qb(u)
		elseif(t=='h008')then
			set t=GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(u))
			set yi[t]=yi[t]-1
		elseif(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A0DS')>0)then
			call rb(u)
		elseif(t=='h061')then
			call Pb(u)
		endif
		call FlushChildHashtable(gr,GetHandleId(u))
		call GroupRemoveUnit(Oa,u)
		call GroupRemoveUnit(Da,u)
		set u=GetKillingUnit()
		if(u!=null and oX)then
			set t=ea[GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(u))]
			set Ki[t]=Ki[t]+1
			call qd(3,t+1,I2S(Ki[t]))
		endif
	endif
	set k=null
	set u=null
endfunction
